display.purpose: The 'arr' logotype in sidebar/mobile header. Never used for page headings or body copy.

title.purpose: Card titles, dialog titles, section headings.

body.purpose: Default weight for nearly all interface copy.

label.purpose: Badges, timestamps, muted metadata, kbd hints.

shadows.name: card
shadows.purpose: The only shadow used on cards. Nothing in the system escalates past it.

motion.name: state-transition
motion.purpose: Shared background/color/border/transform transition on buttons and links.

motion.name: tap-scale-hover
motion.purpose: Press-affordance feedback on hover for any .tap-scale element (buttons, cards).

textures.name: grid-backdrop
textures.value: 40px line grid, color-mix(in oklab, var(--foreground) 8%, transparent), radial-gradient mask fading from 50% 35% to transparent at 75%
textures.purpose: Scoped to LoginForm's and /setup's own wrapper only — the one texture the system allows, deliberately not applied to body or to any authenticated/dense view.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Default filled button, used for the main affirmative action in a view (Approve, Save, primary CTAs).
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: oklch(0.21 0.006 285.885); color: oklch(0.985 0 0); padding: 8px 16px; border: none; border-radius: 0; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 500; font-family: Manrope, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; transition: background-color 180ms ease, transform 160ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: color-mix(in oklab, oklch(0.21 0.006 285.885) 90%, white); transform: scale(1.02); } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: scale(0.97); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px oklch(0.871 0.006 286.286 / 0.5); }

components.name: Outline Button
components.description: Secondary action button — search trigger, cancel, retry.
components.css: .ds-btn-outline { background: oklch(1 0 0); color: oklch(0.141 0.005 285.823); padding: 8px 16px; border: 1px solid oklch(0.92 0.004 286.32); border-radius: 0; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 500; box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgba(0,0,0,0.04); transition: background-color 180ms ease, transform 160ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1); } .ds-btn-outline:hover { background: oklch(0.967 0.001 286.375); transform: scale(1.02); } .ds-btn-outline:active { transform: scale(0.97); }

components.name: Card
components.description: Base container for requests, stat tiles, settings panels.
components.css: .ds-card { background: oklch(1 0 0); color: oklch(0.141 0.005 285.823); border-radius: 0; box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgba(0,0,0,0.05), 0 1px 1px rgba(0,0,0,0.03); padding: 24px; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 24px; } .ds-card-title { font-weight: 600; font-size: 1rem; line-height: 1; } .ds-card-body { font-size: 0.875rem; color: oklch(0.552 0.016 285.938); }

components.name: Input
components.description: Text field used throughout forms (search, settings, reject-reason).
components.css: .ds-input { height: 36px; width: 100%; border: 1px solid oklch(0.92 0.004 286.32); background: transparent; border-radius: 0; padding: 4px 12px; font-size: 0.875rem; box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgba(0,0,0,0.04); transition: box-shadow 150ms ease; } .ds-input::placeholder { color: oklch(0.552 0.016 285.938); } .ds-input:focus-visible { outline: none; border-color: oklch(0.871 0.006 286.286); box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px oklch(0.871 0.006 286.286 / 0.5); }

components.name: Instance Status Badge
components.description: Signature component: the four-state honesty indicator for a *arr instance's reachability. Not configured / Disabled / Unreachable / Enabled.
components.css: .ds-badge { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; padding: 2px 8px; border-radius: 0; font-size: 0.75rem; font-weight: 500; font-family: Manrope, sans-serif; } .ds-badge--default { background: oklch(0.21 0.006 285.885); color: oklch(0.985 0 0); } .ds-badge--secondary { background: oklch(0.967 0.001 286.375); color: oklch(0.21 0.006 285.885); } .ds-badge--destructive { background: oklch(0.577 0.245 27.325); color: #fff; } .ds-badge--outline { background: transparent; color: oklch(0.141 0.005 285.823); border: 1px solid oklch(0.92 0.004 286.32); }

components.name: Stat Tile
components.description: Requests-overview metric card: icon + label + colored count. Four instances (Total/Active/Available/Failed) share this exact shape, differing only by tone.
components.css: .ds-stat { background: oklch(1 0 0); border-radius: 0; box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgba(0,0,0,0.05); padding: 16px; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 4px; } .ds-stat-label { font-size: 0.75rem; color: oklch(0.552 0.016 285.938); } .ds-stat-value { font-size: 1.5rem; font-weight: 600; } .ds-stat-value--success { color: #059669; }

narrative.overview:
Every visual choice serves one product promise: state you can trust at a glance. The system is a near-flat, near-neutral shadcn/ui foundation (Tailwind 4, sharp square corners, shadow-xs/shadow-sm only) that stays out of the way for 95% of any screen — grayscale surfaces, thin 1px borders, Manrope for all reading text. The one place the UI is allowed to raise its voice is status: a request's badge, an instance's health, a stat card's tone. Color there is never decorative — default (dark neutral) means healthy/active, destructive red means failed or unreachable, secondary gray means in-progress, outline means not-yet-configured or awaiting. The Fraunces serif wordmark is the system's only ornament, reserved for the "arr" logotype and nothing else — a small warmth against an otherwise utilitarian, restrained-and-precise surface.

Three-way theming (light / dark / system, via next-themes) is a first-class constraint, not an afterthought: every token is defined once in :root and re-mapped in .dark, never hardcoded per-component.
keyCharacteristics: Grayscale-first surface; color is reserved for status, never for brand decoration.
Flat by default — shadow-xs/shadow-sm only, no layered elevation.
Sharp, modern geometry — square corners everywhere, no rounding.
One serif accent (Fraunces) on the wordmark; everything else is Manrope.
tap-scale press feedback (scale 1.02 hover / 0.97 active) is the system's one shared micro-interaction, applied uniformly via a CSS utility rather than per-component hover:scale-*.
Light/dark/system theming is structural, not optional.

rules.name: The Status-Only Color Rule
rules.body: Outside of the library composition chart, saturated color exists to report state (success/failure/warning/active), never to decorate a surface. If a color isn't reporting something, it should be neutral.

rules.name: The One-Serif Rule
rules.body: Fraunces appears exactly once per screen, on the "arr" wordmark. It never appears on page titles, buttons, or body copy — introducing it elsewhere would compete with the wordmark instead of marking it.

rules.name: The Flat-By-Default Rule
rules.body: No component escalates past shadow-sm. If a screen needs more visual separation, reach for a border or a muted-background block before reaching for a bigger shadow.

rules.name: The Square Corner Rule
rules.body: No component earns a radius. If a shape needs to read as "special" (a status tag, a floating panel), separate it with color, weight, or a border — never with a rounded corner.

dos: Do treat color as a status signal first — pick a badge/text variant by what it reports (healthy/in-progress/failed/unconfigured), not by visual preference.
Do reuse the Instance Status Badge's exact four-state mapping for any new reachability/health surface.
Do keep Fraunces confined to the "arr" wordmark; every other heading and body role is Manrope.
Do define new tokens in both :root and .dark at once — no component should hardcode a light-only or dark-only value.
Do apply tap-scale to new interactive elements instead of a bespoke hover:scale-*.
donts: Don't reintroduce a --sea-ink/--lagoon/--palm/--hero-*/--glow-*/--grid-*-style decorative body background or an unlayered body {} rule that paints ahead of @layer base — it painted /login and /setup teal until this pass removed it. Any new top-level page must render inside (or reproduce) bg-background/text-foreground.
Don't introduce any border-radius above 0 — no rounded-sm/md/lg/xl/full on any component. --radius-sm/md/lg/xl are hardcoded to 0px in styles.css, not derived from a --radius base.
Don't introduce a shadow past shadow-sm.
Don't add a fourth or fifth library-composition chart color (chart-4/chart-5 exist in :root but back no real media kind today).
Don't hardcode a status color as a literal Tailwind class on a one-off element when an existing Badge/stat-tone convention already covers that meaning.
